scope.phase: localized route after English baseline navigation

expected: Localized document navigation returns HTTP 200 for the G4 route contract.
actual: Firefox returned HTTP 304 on the localized navigation after visiting the English baseline route. Build and isolated preview startup both passed; the failure occurred at tests/localization-runtime.spec.ts:193.
hypothesis: The Vite preview server/browser cache interaction revalidated the shared SPA HTML document during cross-locale navigation, producing a 304 instead of the contract-required deterministic 200.
repair: Configured Vite preview response headers with Cache-Control: no-store so preview document navigations are not browser-revalidated from a prior locale response.
next_action: Verify a fresh Firefox matrix unit on the repair SHA and confirm the localized navigation remains HTTP 200 without weakening G4 assertions.
